text_blocks.snippet: The rate of spread of penile cancer varies depending on several factors, including:

list.snippet: Type of cancer: Squamous cell carcinoma, the most common type, typically spreads slowly.
Stage of cancer: Early-stage cancers (confined to the penis) tend to spread more slowly than advanced-stage cancers (which have spread to lymph nodes or other organs).
Individual patient factors: Factors such as age, overall health, and immune system can influence the rate of spread.
